name: ingestion/ProgressEvent
purpose_statement: Append-only machine-readable progress emitted by explicit Ingestion sidecar runs.

field_descriptions.status: running, succeeded, failed, cancelled, blocked, or skipped.
field_descriptions.source_path: File or folder currently being processed.
field_descriptions.scanned_files: Cumulative files scanned by this run.
field_descriptions.written_records: Cumulative app-owned records written by this run.
